evidence.title: Top conservative group unveils full-court press in key battleground state to expose ‘shocking’ Dem platform

occurrences.checkable_against: SBA Pro-Life America organizational records and Iowa campaign activity records
occurrences.quote_span: One of the largest pro-life organizations in the country is pouring time and resources into the high-stakes battleground of Iowa, making the case that voters of all backgrounds will be "shocked" to know where the Democratic Party stands on abortion.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America Iowa voter-contact program

occurrences.checkable_against: Women Speak Out PAC campaign spending records
occurrences.quote_span: a $1.35 million spend from the Women Speak Out PAC, SBA’s super PAC, to contact voters in the Iowa universe.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America Iowa voter-contact program

occurrences.checkable_against: SBA canvasser contact reports and voter survey data
occurrences.quote_span: "Most people we're finding are pro-life, regardless of the way that they vote and we want to make sure that they're aware of the candidate's views on abortion and pro-life and we wanna make sure they're making knowledgeable and informed decisions when they go to the polls."
occurrences.speaker: Amy Elizabeth
occurrences.subject: Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America Iowa voter-contact program

occurrences.checkable_against: SBA Pro-Life America Iowa canvassing records
occurrences.quote_span: Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America’s ground game has knocked on over 172,000 doors in Iowa promoting the Republican ticket in the Hawkeye State.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America Iowa voter-contact program

occurrences.checkable_against: SBA canvassing contact reports and voter response measures
occurrences.quote_span: Elizabeth told Fox News Digital that the conversations with voters on the ground have been effective.
occurrences.speaker: Amy Elizabeth
occurrences.subject: Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America Iowa voter-contact program

occurrences.checkable_against: Polling cited by SBA Pro-Life America and SBA voter-contact survey records
occurrences.quote_span: "Polling shows the vast majority of Americans reject this, and our team at the doors is finding it true visit after visit.
occurrences.speaker: Marjorie Dannenfelser
occurrences.subject: Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America Iowa voter-contact program

occurrences.checkable_against: SBA canvassing activity logs and Fox News Digital reporting from Cedar Rapids
occurrences.quote_span: Fox News Digital was on the ground in Iowa with SBA canvassers in Cedar Rapids on Tuesday, where the team passed out flyers and spoke to voters in support of Iowa Republican Sen. Ashley Hinson and hammered the abortion positions of Democratic gubernatorial candidate Rob Sand.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America Iowa voter-contact program

occurrences.checkable_against: SBA Pro-Life America and Women Speak Out PAC campaign spending records
occurrences.quote_span: Additionally, the group has a planned digital spend of $650,000 to go along with a $1.35 million spend from the Women Speak Out PAC, SBA’s super PAC, to contact voters in the Iowa universe.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America Iowa voter-contact program

occurrences.checkable_against: SBA Pro-Life America campaign field program materials
occurrences.quote_span: "Our goal really is just to inform voters," SBA field rep Amy Elizabeth told Fox News Digital.
occurrences.speaker: Amy Elizabeth
occurrences.subject: Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America Iowa voter-contact program

occurrences.checkable_against: SBA Pro-Life America voter-contact program records and comparable national pro-life outreach programs
occurrences.quote_span: "The scale of SBA Pro-Life America’s voter contact program is among the largest in the nation and certainly the largest in the pro-life movement," SBA President Marjorie Dannenfelser told Fox News Digital.
occurrences.speaker: Marjorie Dannenfelser
occurrences.subject: Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America Iowa voter-contact program

occurrences.checkable_against: SBA Pro-Life America and Women Speak Out PAC Iowa voter-contact records
occurrences.quote_span: Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America and Women Speak Out PAC announced in August that their Iowa voter-contact program had surpassed 100,000 visits to voters’ homes in the Des Moines, Davenport and Cedar Rapids areas.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America Iowa voter-contact program
